title: New Testament Stories
intro: Stories from the life of Jesus and his first followers.

questions.prompt: In which town was Jesus born?
questions.explanation: Matthew 2:1 says Jesus was born in Bethlehem in Judea.

questions.prompt: How many apostles did Jesus choose?
questions.explanation: Luke 6:13 says Jesus chose twelve of his disciples and called them apostles.

questions.prompt: Who baptised Jesus in the River Jordan?
questions.explanation: Matthew 3:13 tells how Jesus came to John at the Jordan to be baptised.

questions.prompt: What work did Peter and Andrew do before they followed Jesus?
questions.explanation: Matthew 4:18 says Peter and Andrew were casting a net into the lake, for they were fishermen.

questions.prompt: In Jesus' parable, who stopped to help the injured traveller?
questions.explanation: In Luke 10, a priest and a Levite pass by, but a Samaritan takes pity on the man and cares for him.

questions.prompt: When Jesus fed the five thousand, how many loaves did a boy share?
questions.explanation: John 6:9 says a boy had five small barley loaves and two small fish.

questions.prompt: Jesus turned water into wine at a wedding in Cana.
questions.explanation: John 2 describes this as the first of the signs Jesus performed, at a wedding in Cana in Galilee.

questions.prompt: Who climbed a sycamore-fig tree to see Jesus over the crowd?
questions.explanation: Luke 19 says Zacchaeus was short, so he ran ahead and climbed a sycamore-fig tree to see Jesus.

questions.prompt: On the road to which city did Saul see a bright light from heaven?
questions.explanation: Acts 9:3 says that as Saul neared Damascus, a light from heaven flashed around him. He later became known as Paul.

questions.prompt: In Matthew's Gospel, for how many days and nights did Jesus fast in the wilderness?
questions.explanation: Matthew 4:2 says Jesus fasted for forty days and forty nights.

questions.prompt: Which angel visited Mary to tell her she would have a baby called Jesus?
questions.explanation: Luke's Gospel says the angel Gabriel was sent by God to Mary in Nazareth with the news.

questions.prompt: Where did Mary lay baby Jesus because there was no room for them?

options.label: In a basket by a river

questions.explanation: A manger is a feeding trough for animals. Luke says Mary laid Jesus there because there was no guest room.

questions.prompt: Who did angels visit in the fields at night to share the news of Jesus' birth?
questions.explanation: Shepherds were watching their sheep when angels appeared and told them a saviour had been born.

questions.prompt: What did the wise men follow to find the young Jesus?
questions.explanation: Matthew says the wise men saw a star and followed it until it stopped over the place where Jesus was.

questions.prompt: The wise men brought gold, frankincense and which other gift?
questions.explanation: Myrrh is a sweet-smelling resin from a tree. It was a precious gift, like gold and frankincense.

questions.prompt: In which town did Jesus grow up?
questions.explanation: After Jesus was born in Bethlehem, his family returned to their home town of Nazareth in Galilee.

questions.prompt: According to Matthew's Gospel, people called Jesus the carpenter's son.
questions.explanation: In Matthew, people in Jesus' home town asked, "Isn't this the carpenter's son?" because Joseph was a carpenter.

questions.prompt: Which disciple stepped out of a boat to walk on the water towards Jesus?
questions.explanation: Peter walked on the water, then became afraid of the wind and began to sink. Jesus reached out and caught him.

questions.prompt: In Jesus' story of the two builders, the wise man built his house on sand.
questions.explanation: The wise man built on rock, so his house stood firm. The foolish man built on sand and his house fell.

questions.prompt: In the parable of the lost son, what job did the younger son take when his money ran out?
questions.explanation: The son was so hungry looking after pigs that he decided to go home and say sorry to his father.

questions.prompt: In the parable of the lost son, the father ran to welcome his son home.
questions.explanation: The father saw his son far away, ran to him and hugged him, then threw a party to celebrate.

questions.prompt: In Jesus' parable of the lost sheep, how many sheep did the shepherd have altogether?
questions.explanation: The shepherd had 100 sheep. He left the 99 to search for the one that was lost, and was full of joy when he found it.

questions.prompt: How many men with leprosy did Jesus heal on the way to Jerusalem, before only one came back to say thank you?
questions.explanation: Ten men were healed, but only one returned to thank Jesus, and Jesus praised him for it.

questions.prompt: Which friend of Jesus, from Bethany, did Jesus call out of his tomb alive?
questions.explanation: John's Gospel tells how Jesus called, "Lazarus, come out!" and his friend walked out of the tomb.

questions.prompt: Which sister sat at Jesus' feet listening while Martha was busy getting things ready?
questions.explanation: Martha was busy with all the preparations, while her sister Mary sat and listened to Jesus' teaching.

questions.prompt: On which animal did Jesus ride into Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: John's Gospel says Jesus found a young donkey and sat on it, as crowds waved palm branches.

questions.prompt: Matthew was working as what when Jesus called him to follow?
questions.explanation: Jesus saw Matthew sitting at the tax collector's booth and said, "Follow me", and Matthew got up and followed him.

questions.prompt: Mary Magdalene was one of the first people to see Jesus after he rose again.
questions.explanation: John's Gospel says Mary Magdalene met Jesus near the empty tomb and then went to tell the disciples.

questions.prompt: At Pentecost, what appeared to rest on each of the disciples?
questions.explanation: Acts says the disciples heard a sound like a mighty wind and saw what looked like tongues of fire resting on each of them.

questions.prompt: On which island was Paul shipwrecked on his way to Rome?
questions.explanation: After the ship broke up, everyone reached the shore safely and found the island was called Malta.
